members: [untitled BTM module] The grouping is anchored on post-transcriptional and transcriptional control of gene expression in neural and developing tissues. Three sequence-specific RNA-binding proteins carry much of its identity: the neuronal ELAV-family protein ELAVL3 and the cytoplasmic polyadenylation element binding protein CPEB3 govern stability, localisation and translation of mRNAs in neurons, where CPEB3 acts on transcripts encoding glutamate receptor subunits and contributes to synaptic plasticity and memory, while YBX1 is a broadly acting mRNA packaging and translational regulator.
